provenance.repository_documentation: src/GeometryHelper.Drawing/plan/78-dwg.md and tests/GeometryHelper.UnitTest/Dwg/DwgAnswerKey.cs describe GhDwg4 running inside AutoCAD 2021, saving DWG, reopening it in AutoCAD, and writing paired DXF answer keys.
provenance.limitations: The probe plugin/API-call source is not present in the pinned repository. This is a documented AutoCAD-produced candidate, but exact original TABLE API state and authored values are not independently preserved. Do not treat the pair alone as complete producer-bound semantic proof.

fixture.repository_fixture_policy: Downloaded/decompressed only under /private/tmp; do not add third-party fixture files or derivatives to this repository.

source_pair_observations.dxf_linked_cell_flags: All group 92 positions classified as the linked-data flag by ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.97 are zero. Two other group 92 values of 4 occur inside CONTENTFORMAT records and are not linked-data flags.
source_pair_observations.notes: The AcDbLinkedData/AcDbLinkedTableData subclass names describe the TABLECONTENT inheritance chain; they do not establish linked cells. The paired DXF has no explicit DATALINK record, and its linked-cell flags are zero. Two ACAD_TABLE records include handles 7A and 7C; TABLECONTENT is 9B and TABLEGEOMETRY is 9C.

libdxfrw_observation.dwg_read: Success; source AC1032; zero entity and object parse failures.
libdxfrw_observation.diagnostic: DXF export preflight failed: TABLECONTENT linked cell lacks one emitted DATALINK target or complete DWG semantics
libdxfrw_observation.preflight_interpretation: The debug trace confirms the ODA-specified TV candidate stops at the first cell, then the bounded AC1032 body-byte-count fallback is accepted and explicitly sets semanticComplete=false. Preflight rejects this incomplete DWG semantic projection; the generic diagnostic combines that condition with a missing DATALINK target. No linked-cell read was logged, and the paired DXF marks linked-cell flags zero. The observed refusal is therefore not evidence of a missing DATALINK in this profile.

next_steps: Keep the AC1032 body-byte-count TABLECONTENT fallback bounded, raw-retaining and semantic-incomplete; strict output refusal remains required.
The exact 4-byte HEADER warning is a validated high-size-word compatibility observation with matching CRC and zero unclaimed bytes; do not treat it as a source failure.

Resume only with the missing AutoCAD 2021 probe/API source state or a source-distinct producer-bound table witness that binds row/cell values, format roles and any references. Do not infer native meaning from the paired DXF alone.

After that source gate closes, prove physical spans/next-frame alignment, graph closure, independent output/readback and native table meaning. Keep downloaded fixtures and derivatives outside the repository.

The 842-to-846 row is the explicit HeaderSectionCompatibility warning emitted for this candidate, not a HEADER bounds/CRC/suffix failure.
code_disposition.plan_effect: Remove the 4-byte warning from open P6-C work; do not change the parser or repeat HEADER/suffix scans for this unchanged source.
